text:
Type: tall two-door storage cabinet
Use: storing clothes, toys and supplies behind doors; children's room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board body, birch wood-look doors, cut-out finger grip
Colors: light natural birch, white
Shape: narrow upright box with two full-height doors meeting at the center, rectangular cut-out handle, flat top, sits flush on the floor, simple and slim, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, light, calm, tidy
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, pastel textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms and bedrooms

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
